pages.lesson:
LESSON: SEWING SKILLS: CONSTRUCTING HOUSEHOLD ITEMS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: PRODUCTION TECHNIQUES
Topic 4.1: Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items
2. Practise Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items in the examples.
2. Explain Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items
2. Practise Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
